74751-anthology-of-modern-indian-poetry.creator: Unknown

And a dimness of tears to stir the dust of Hope to life. “Ah, Unfettered One!” I have included some translations of Indian songs as sung by native singers, because I thought they might be of interest from an indigenous point of view.

arxiv-2107-03759.title: Analytically Tractable Hidden-States Inference in Bayesian Neural Networks
arxiv-2107-03759.creator: Luong Ha Nguyen and James-A. Goulet Department of Civil, Geologic and Mining Engineering Polytechnique Montréal , CANADA
arxiv-2107-03759.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Luong Ha Nguyen and James-A. Goulet Department of Civil, Geologic and Mining Engineering Polytechnique Montréal , CANADA. With few exceptions, neural networks have been relying on backpropagation and gradient descent as the inference engine in order to learn the model parameters, because the closed-form Bayesian inference for neural networks has been considered to be intractable.

arxiv-2108-04487.title: Measurement of the temperature dependence of dwell time and spin relaxation probability of Rb atoms on paraffin surfaces using a beam-scattering method
arxiv-2108-04487.creator: Kanta Asakawa 1, Yutaro Tanaka 1, Kenta Uemura 1, Norihiro Matsuzaka 2, Kunihiro Nishikawa 1, Yuki Oguma 1, Hiroaki Usui 2, Atsushi Hatakeyama 1
arxiv-2108-04487.description: Abstract The scattering of Rb atoms on an anti-relaxation coating was studied. No significant change in the spin relaxation probability of Rb atoms by single scattering from a tetracontane surface was observed by cooling the film from 305 to 123 K. The mean surface dwell time was estimated using a time-resolved method.

arxiv-2111-07606.title: Discriminative Mutual Information Estimation for the Design of Channel Capacity Driven Autoencoders
arxiv-2111-07606.creator: Nunzio A. Letizia and Andrea M. Tonello
arxiv-2111-07606.description: Abstract The development of optimal and efficient machine learning-based communication systems is likely to be a key enabler of beyond 5G communication technologies. In this direction, physical layer design has been recently reformulated under a deep learning framework where the autoencoder paradigm foresees the full communication system as an end-to-end coding-decoding problem.

arxiv-2203-10464.title: Concentrations for nonlinear Schrödinger equation with magnetic potential and constant electric potential Thanks: The two authors are partially supported by NSFC 11971169 and Natural Science Foundation of Shanghai 22ZR1421600.
arxiv-2203-10464.creator: Liping Wang, Chunyi Zhao
arxiv-2203-10464.description: Abstract . This paper studies the concentration phenomena to nonlinear Schrödinger equations with magnetic potential and constant electric potential. The existing results show that the magnetic field has no effect on the location of point concentrations, as long as the electric potential is not constant.

arxiv-2212-12675.title: Iterative regularization in classification via hinge loss diagonal descent
arxiv-2212-12675.creator: Vassilis Apidopoulos, Tomaso Poggio, Lorenzo Rosasco, Silvia Villa
arxiv-2212-12675.description: Abstract Iterative regularization is a classic idea in regularization theory, that has recently become popular in machine learning. On the one hand, it allows to design efficient algorithms controlling at the same time numerical and statistical accuracy. On the other hand it allows to shed light on the learning curves observed while training neural networks.

arxiv-2311-07950.title: Study of the Blazhko type RRc stars in the Stripe 82 region using SDSS and ZTF
arxiv-2311-07950.creator: Vaidehi Varma, József M. Benkő, Chow-Choong Ngeow
arxiv-2311-07950.description: Abstract RR Lyrae stars are pulsating stars, many of which also show a long-term variation called the Blazhko effect which is a modulation of amplitude and phase of the lightcurve. In this work, we searched for the incidence rate of the Blazhko effect in the first-overtone pulsating RR Lyrae (RRc) stars of the Galactic halo.

arxiv-2404-10674.title: Climbing to the Top of the ATLAS 13 TeV data
arxiv-2404-10674.creator: The ATLAS Collaboration
arxiv-2404-10674.description: Abstract The large amount of data recorded with the ATLAS detector at the Large Hadron Collider, corresponding to 140 fb -1 of p ​ p pp collisions at a centre-of-mass energy of s = 13 \sqrt{s}=13 TeV, has brought our knowledge of the top quark to a higher level.

arxiv-2408-03502.title: Role Identification based Method for Cyberbullying Analysis in Social Edge Computing
arxiv-2408-03502.creator: Runyu Wang, Tun Lu, Peng Zhang, Ning Gu
arxiv-2408-03502.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Runyu Wang, Tun Lu, Peng Zhang, Ning Gu. Over the past few years, many efforts have been dedicated to studying cyberbullying in social edge computing devices, and most of them focus on three roles: victims, perpetrators, and bystanders. If we want to obtain a deep insight into the formation, evolution, and intervention of cyberbullying in devices at the edge of the Internet, it is necessary to explore more fine-grained roles.

arxiv-2505-08389.title: Towards Contamination Resistant Benchmarks
arxiv-2505-08389.creator: Rahmatullah Musawi, LU Sheng
arxiv-2505-08389.description: Abstract The rapid development of large language models (LLMs) has transformed the landscape of natural language processing. Evaluating LLMs properly is crucial for understanding their potential and addressing concerns such as safety. However, LLM evaluation is confronted by various factors, among which contamination stands out as a key issue that undermines the reliability of evaluations.

With around 200 detections of exoplanets around giant stars to date, our knowledge of the population of exoplanets orbiting evolved hosts more massive than the Sun remains limited.

arxiv-2505-24156.title: Towards a Generalizable Bimanual Foundation Policy via Flow-based Video Prediction
arxiv-2505-24156.creator: Chenyou Fan Fangzheng Yan Chenjia Bai Jiepeng Wang, Chi Zhang Zhen Wang Xuelong Li
arxiv-2505-24156.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Chenyou Fan Fangzheng Yan Chenjia Bai Jiepeng Wang, Chi Zhang Zhen Wang Xuelong Li. Learning a generalizable bimanual manipulation policy is extremely challenging for embodied agents due to the large action space and the need for coordinated arm movements. Existing approaches rely on Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models to acquire bimanual policies. However, transferring knowledge from single-arm datasets or pre-trained VLA models often fails to generalize effectively, primarily due to the scarcity of bimanual data and the fundamental differences between single-arm and bimanual manipulation.

arxiv-2508-03095.title: A Survey of AI Agent Registry Solutions
arxiv-2508-03095.creator: Aditi Singh, Abul Ehtesham, Ramesh Raskar, Mahesh Lambe
arxiv-2508-03095.description: Abstract As autonomous AI agents scale across cloud, enterprise, and decentralized environments, the need for standardized registry systems to support discovery, identity, and capability sharing has become essential. This paper surveys three prominent registry approaches each defined by a unique metadata model: MCP’s mcp.json, A2A’s Agent Card, and NANDA’s AgentFacts.

arxiv-2509-18700.title: Enhancing Automatic Chord Recognition through LLM Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
arxiv-2509-18700.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by . Music Information Retrieval (MIR) encompasses a broad range of computational techniques for analyzing and understanding musical content, with recent deep learning advances driving substantial improvements. Building upon these advances, this paper explores how large language models (LLMs) can serve as an integrative bridge to connect and integrate information from multiple MIR tools, with a focus on enhancing automatic chord recognition performance.

arxiv-2509-21735.title: Uncovering Alzheimer’s Disease Progression via SDE-based Spatio-Temporal Graph Deep Learning on Longitudinal Brain Networks
arxiv-2509-21735.creator: Houliang Zhou, Rong Zhou, Yangying Liu, Kanhao Zhao, Li Shen, Brian Y. Chen, Yu Zhang, Lifang He, Alzheimer’s Disease Neuroimaging Initiative
arxiv-2509-21735.description: Abstract Identifying objective neuroimaging biomarkers to forecast Alzheimer’s disease (AD) progression is crucial for timely intervention. However, this task remains challenging due to the complex dysfunctions in the spatio-temporal characteristics of underlying brain networks, which are often overlooked by existing methods.

arxiv-2602-19394.title: Subdiagrams and invariant measures for generalized Bratteli diagrams
arxiv-2602-19394.creator: Sergey Bezuglyi, Palle Jorgensen, Olena Karpel, Thiago Raszeja, Shrey Sanadhya
arxiv-2602-19394.description: Abstract . The results of this paper contribute to the study of invariant measures of Borel dynamical systems that can be modeled using generalized Bratteli diagrams. In this context, we study tail invariant measures on the path spaces of generalized Bratteli diagrams, allowing countably infinite vertex sets at each level.

pmc-10642936.title: Recommender systems for sustainability: overview and research issues
pmc-10642936.creator: Alexander Felfernig, Manfred Wundara, Thi Ngoc Trang Tran, Seda Polat-Erdeniz, Sebastian Lubos, Merfat El Mansi, Damian Garber, Viet-Man Le
pmc-10642936.description: Sustainability development goals (SDGs) are regarded as a universal call to action with the overall objectives of planet protection, ending of poverty, and ensuring peace and prosperity for all people. In order to achieve these objectives, different AI technologies play a major role. Specifically, recommender systems can provide support for organizations and individuals to achieve the defined goals.

pmc-11516216.title: Co-Creating Tailored Solutions to Combat Sedentary Behaviour: Insights from Scottish SMEs
pmc-11516216.creator: M Vogelsang, L McCaffrey, G Ryde, M Verloigne, P Dall
pmc-11516216.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundProlonged sedentary behaviour (SB) poses health risks for office workers, especially in small-to-medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) often overlooked by current interventions. This abstract aims to report and examine solutions developed through co-creation for SB in SMEs.MethodsThree Scottish SMEs, a construction company (n = 150) and two charities (n = 100; n = 30), participated in a co-creation process to create SME-specific actions on SB. Each formed an action group of employees (n = 9-12) as co-creators.

pmc-11517080.title: Association between a new healthcare access index and life expectancy in Japan: A nationwide study
pmc-11517080.creator: A Nakamura, K Takezawa, E Satoh, K Kotani
pmc-11517080.description: BackgroundAccess to medical institutions is crucial to healthcare systems. Japan has universal health coverage and unrestricted access to medical institutions; patients can visit any medical institution without requiring referral letters. We developed the Japan- Spatial Accessibility Scale for Medical Institutions (J-AMI) to provide integrated spatial accessibility to multiple sized healthcare institutions.

pmc-12128795.title: COCCYGODYNIA
pmc-12128795.creator: Neven Elezović, Sanda Stojanović Stipić, Mate Perković, Anela Elezović, Toni Elezović
pmc-12128795.description: SUMMARYThe coccyx, the last segment of the spine, joins the sacrum at the base. It has three to five vertebrae, which are typically fused. In front of the sacrococcygeal junction is the ganglion impar, the only unpaired autonomic ganglion. The two sympathetic chains come to a close there.

pmc-12573269.title: Emergency zero-fluoroscopy catheter ablation for refractory ventricular tachycardia in third-trimester pregnancy: a case report
pmc-12573269.creator: Guiying Liu, Shuping Quan, Xiongbiao Chen, Xianyou Zhang
pmc-12573269.description: BackgroundThe incidence of symptomatic arrhythmias during pregnancy has markedly increased in recent years. Atrial fibrillation/flutter and life-threatening ventricular arrhythmias are of particular concern due to their association with elevated maternal and fetal risks. Cardioversion, antiarrhythmic drugs, or catheter ablation are treatment options for hemodynamically unstable arrhythmias.

pmc-12736057.title: Polycyclic Aromatic Hydrocarbons and Microbial Contamination in Traditional Pork Meat Products: Implications for Food Safety
pmc-12736057.creator: Alexandra Tabaran, Oana Lucia Crisan-Reget, Dana Alina Magdas, Mihai Borzan, Sergiu Condor, Caroline Lǎcǎtuş, Sorin Daniel Dan
pmc-12736057.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Traditional pork meat products produced through artisanal smoking and drying techniques are highly appreciated for their distinctive sensory characteristics; however, such practices may raise concerns regarding both chemical and microbiological safety. The present study aimed to assess the occurrence of selected polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) and hygiene- and safety-related microorganisms in traditionally processed pork meat products collected from local markets and small-scale producers.

pmc-12754581.title: Biological relationship between Parkinson's disease and gallstone disease
pmc-12754581.creator: Chao Jiang, Jingying Ma, Jingyu Mu, Yuanyuan Fu, Yan Zhao, Yiming You, Zhiqiang Cui, Chuang Guo
pmc-12754581.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Compelling evidence indicates a significant connection between dysfunction of the gastrointestinal tract, the gut microbiome, and Parkinson's disease (PD), which aligns with the notion of the “gut–brain axis”. While the exact mechanisms involved in gut–brain interactions are still not fully understood, the high incidence of gastrointestinal symptoms during the early stages of PD aids in the development of diagnostic biomarkers and prospective disease‐modifying therapies.

pmc-13045947.title: Laparoscopic partial pericystectomy for a giant hepatic hydatid cyst in an 8-year-old child: a case report
pmc-13045947.creator: Rahul Jha, Sabin Kumar Ghimire, Sanjay Kumar Kushwaha, Rishika Prasad, Rabin Kumar Ghimire, Sushil Dhungel
pmc-13045947.description: Introduction:Hydatid cyst of the liver is a zoonotic disease caused by the larvae of Echinococcus granulosus. It is endemic in countries like South America, Africa, Asia, and China. Giant hepatic hydatid cysts are rare in children and carry a higher risk of complications.

pmc-13144730.title: Condensin loop extrusion properties, roadblocks, and role in homology search during recombination in S. cerevisiae
pmc-13144730.creator: Vinciane Piveteau, Chloé Dupont, Hossein Salari, Agnès Dumont, Jérôme Savocco, Daniel Jost, Aurèle Piazza
pmc-13144730.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The in vivo mechanism, cis-acting roadblocks, and biological functions of DNA loop extrusion by eukaryotic SMC complexes remain incompletely defined. Here, we identify condensin-dependent Hi-C contact stripes at the recombination enhancer (RE) and at rDNA in S. The RE is an autonomous condensin loading site only active in MATa cells from which oriented, unidirectional loop extrusion proceeds with an estimated processivity ~150–250 kb and a density ~0.04–0.18 that varies across the cell cycle.

pmc-13380787.title: Ultrasound-mediated piezoelectricity enhancement in bioresorbable polymers
pmc-13380787.creator: Xinchang Kang, Yawu Li, Ruiyue Zhao, Yi Yuan, Qi Chen, Pengyu Li, Zhengbao Yang, Jianglin Wang
pmc-13380787.description: Piezoelectric materials can power self-sustained medical devices, but biodegradable systems with high performance remain elusive. We introduce a high-frequency ultrasound treatment strategy that enhances the piezoelectricity of poly-L-lactide (PLLA) via standing-wave-induced crystallization and ferroelectric electret formation. Ultrasound at 1.2 MHz promotes β-form crystal alignment, increasing the piezoelectric coefficient (d33) to 10.8 pC/N, approaching that of non-degradable PVDF.

pmc-13473036.title: Accuracy of seven three-dimensional facial scanning systems compared with cone-beam computed tomography: a pilot study
pmc-13473036.creator: Anna Dovhan, Dmytro Filonenko, Roman Palyvoda
pmc-13473036.description: Accurate three-dimensional (3D) reproduction of facial soft-tissue geometry is a prerequisite for planning and fabricating maxillofacial epitheses. This single-subject pilot study compared the surface agreement of seven 3D facial scanning configurations available on the Ukrainian market against a cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT)-derived reference surface, reporting trueness-related surface-deviation metrics and acquisition time.

pmc-13621190.title: Flecainide reduces exercise-induced arrhythmic burden in PKP2-related arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy

pmc-13621190.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). mplex ventricular ectopy/non-sustained ventricular tachycardia during the recovery phase of exercise stress testing (EST) that may correlate with future risk of sustained ventricular arrhythmias (VA).2 Although the use of serial ESTs to monitor therapeutic efficacy and guide treatment intensification is well established for catecholaminergic polymorphic ventricular tachycardia (CPVT),3,4 whether a similar approach could be utilized for PKP2-ACM, particularly given the efficacy and increased utilization of flecainide therapy in ACM5 remains to be seen.

uslaw-usc-t49-s46318.title: 49 U.S.C. § 46318 — Interference with cabin or flight crew
uslaw-usc-t49-s46318.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t49-s46318.description: United States Code, Title 49 (Transportation); Part A (Air Commerce And Safety); Subpart iv (Enforcement And Penalties); Chapter 463 (Penalties). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) General Rule.— An individual who physically or sexually assaults or threatens to physically or sexually assault a member of the flight crew or cabin crew of a civil aircraft or any other individual on the aircraft.
